summary: Pacific Gas and Electric Company filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a proposed offering of first mortgage bonds in two series. The filing includes placeholder terms for aggregate principal amounts, interest rates, maturities, and pricing, with joint book-running managers Barclays, BMO Capital Markets, J.P. Morgan, and SMBC Nikko. The bonds will be secured by a first lien on substantially all real property and related tangible personal property. Proceeds are intended for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special-situation event; no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic action is involved.
